decision_impact: Proceed with a default-off Python scratch-buffer init policy limited to decode scratch tensors whose writers are batch_gemm_softmax, torch.sum/topk, gather_copy_vectors, gather_copy_and_concat, CUDA graph query copies, or weighted_flash_decoding output copies. Compare one candidate against opt013 and rerun automatically only if the first round passes.
material_updates: torch.empty remains uninitialized unless deterministic fill_uninitialized_memory is active; do not read before overwrite.
CUDA graph replay is safe only when static graph input/output tensors are explicitly overwritten before use.
